missionFit.rule: Cover consequential credit-union industry developments with a concrete, source-supported implication for CU decision makers. AI and technology remain signature strengths, not mandatory angles. Material regulation, finance, lending, payments, member service, workforce, competition and governance qualify without an invented AI connection. Reject routine personnel notices, promotion-only releases and generic developments without meaningful CU consequence.
examplesInScope: payments, identity, cybersecurity and data technology
AI workforce, vendor and compliance implementation
Material CU regulation, financial performance, consolidation and member-impact developments without a technology angle
Official model and workplace-AI changes with verified availability and a concrete CU implication

productionBehavior: Candidates that pass hard stops and score at or above the minimum publish directly to main. Failed candidates are logged with reasons and do not request routine human approval.

statePersistence.rule: After the article package has persisted the dated daily-cycle outcome, a connector-only runtime must not perform a second whole-file replacement merely to finalize deployment or social fields. Treat automation/social-queue.json and the coverage ledger as authoritative for final distribution truth. If daily-cycle reconciliation is still useful, defer it to a checkout-capable, history-preserving path that runs scripts/validate-daily-cycle-preservation.mjs against current main and re-fetches the committed blob for strict UTF-8/JSON and preservation verification.
statePersistence.reason: The September 9 and September 14 secondary finalization writes corrupted the append-style daily-cycle ledger despite the primary publication outcome already being safely persisted.

cycleOwnership.articleCycle: Owns News and Insights only: one primary article each weekday, plus one distinct qualified article Monday, Wednesday and Friday. Maximum two per day; no Alerts. Never extend the cycle to fill weak slots.
cycleOwnership.alertCycle: Owns Alerts separately under automation/scheduled-tasks/cuai-operating-system.md. It may publish at most one genuinely new, time-sensitive, qualified Alert per weekday and has no quota or minimum target. Any legacy alert target count in daily-cycle-state.json is non-authoritative metadata and must not drive publication behavior.

standardCycle.completionRule: Use fullArticleTargetByWeekday for the Eastern date. Each article independently passes all gates, uses a distinct event and preferably different beat/format, and is committed and production-verified sequentially. Stop at the dated target or after exhausting the bounded candidate pool and fallbacks. Preserve earlier same-day publications and counts; never overwrite them with a zero-publication outcome for a later slot. Alerts remain separate.
standardCycle.shortfallRule: Never weaken evidence, mission-fit or quality gates to fill a slot. When the article target remains unfilled, record the candidates evaluated, rejection reason for each, beats and sources searched, and the exact evidence gap. The separate Alert cycle records a no-Alert outcome when nothing qualifies; that is not a quota shortfall.

expansionReview.target: 8 articles per full week; partial first week is not a full-week shortfall
expansionReview.formatRule: Aim for at least three formats and five functions per week. At most two framework/checklist articles combined per week absent a recorded material-news exception. No rigid topic quota and no padding.
expansionReview.nextStage: 10 per week is a proposal only after review, not authorized automatic escalation.
expansionReview.continueCriteria: At least 14 of 16 intended slots across two complete weeks, all published packages verified, no unresolved material sourcing/production failure, no new recurring spend, and available engagement reviewed without inventing missing evidence.
expansionReview.stopOrRevise: Pause second slots on material sourcing/deployment failures or exhausted existing usage; retain healthy primary cycle. If 14 of16 is missed, resolve source or capacity shortfalls before expansion. Missing audience data cannot justify 10/week.
